entries.subject: ESA/Hubble heic1317a (Hubble ACS)
entries.finding: The 2013 Hubble Heritage image in visible and near-infrared light; 4002 x 3863 px over 3.33 x 3.22 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. Registered against Gaia DR3.

entries.subject: ESA/Hubble heic0805d (Hubble ACS, 2008)
entries.finding: The earlier Hubble image of the same core, 3853 x 4000 px over 3.21 x 3.33 arcmin, with fewer bands and shorter exposure than heic1317a.
